name: Memory Crystal
body:
Aura strong enchantment; CL 13th; Slot none; Price 20,000 gp; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This colorful crystal is created with the ability to store thoughts and memories. A single memory crystal can hold up to 5 pieces of information or memories, or a single spellcaster’s collection of prepared spells. A creature that touches the crystal and speaks the command word can know the general contents of the information stored within.

However, to gain the contents, the user must consciously elect to retrieve the information.

Retrieving information from the memory crystal is a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity and once retrieved, the information is lost from the crystal.

Storing information within the crystal takes 3 full rounds by a willing creature and deals 2d8 damage to the creature storing information.

A specific idea, conclusion, piece of information or a single day’s worth of events can be stored as one of the 5 pieces of information. Once such a thought or memory is stored within the crystal, the information is blotted out of the storer’s memory. For example, a cultist can store the location of their hideout in the crystal and will thus have no means to remember the location of the hideout.

For spells, all 5 pieces of information are taken up by a spellcaster storing their entire day’s worth of prepared spells. Doing so expends the spells as if they were cast for the day. This allows the user to store their spells for later preparation in case they lose access to their spellbook, familiar or similar source for spells to prepare. Only the spellcaster whose spells are stored within the crystal can retrieve the stored spells as newly prepared spells and only when they have sufficient preparable spell slots.

If the memory crystal is destroyed, the thoughts, information, memories and prepared spells are lost with no effect.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells demand, modify memory, thought crystal; Price 10,000 gp
